e.title: Yield Curve Generators (CAS E-Forum)
e.summary: CAS E-Forum 论文《Building and Testing Yield Curve Generators for P&C Insurance》配套代码
e.body:
Yield Curve Generators 是 CAS E-Forum 论文《Building and Testing Yield Curve Generators for P&C Insurance》的配套代码（casact 官方）：构建与测试 P&C 保险语境下的收益率曲线生成器（YCGs）——财产险折现/ALM 的利率情景生成。对 RIAA：P&C 语境收益率曲线生成的官方研究实现。与 [[nelson-siegel-svensson]]（NSS 拟合）、[[smith-wilson-python]]（RFR 外推）、[[esg]]（情景生成）、[[yieldcurves]]（R 曲线工具）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]、[[solvency2rfr]]。

## 同类工具
[[claimsproblems]]、[[deloitte-actuarial-transformation]]、[[dharam]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]

e.summary_hk: CAS E-Forum 論文《Building and Testing Yield Curve Generators for P&C Insurance》配套代碼
e.body_en:
Yield Curve Generators is the companion code of the CAS E-Forum paper 'Building and Testing Yield Curve Generators for P&C Insurance' (official casact): building and testing yield-curve generators (YCGs) in a P&C-insurance context — interest-rate scenario generation for P&C discounting/ALM. For RIAA: the official research implementation of yield-curve generation in a P&C context. Complements [[nelson-siegel-svensson]] (NSS fitting), [[smith-wilson-python]] (RFR extrapolation), [[esg]] (scenario generation) and [[yieldcurves]] (R curve tools). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]], [[solvency2rfr]].

## Similar tools
[[claimsproblems]]、[[deloitte-actuarial-transformation]]、[[dharam]]、[[actsim]]、[[actuarcredibility]]
